title: Oven-Roasted Fluffy Canadian Peanut Butter Casserole
description: A decadent, fluffy Canadian dish featuring peanut brittle and lamination-puff. Best served in a cazuela, this ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly dessert is perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Thoroughly mix the peanut butter, sugar, and vanilla extract in a large bowl until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and melted coconut oil.
Add the peanut brittle, lamination-puff, and crushed peanut brittle to the peanut butter mixture; stir until evenly coated.
Pour the egg mixture over the peanut butter mixture and stir until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a greased cazuela and bake for 40 minutes, or until the dish is golden brown and set.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, topped with chilled heavy cream and a pinch of salt, if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days and reheat in the oven before serving.
Freeze for up to 2 months and thaw at room temperature before serving.
